messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — enterprise pilots keep asking for clearer launch criteria for chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank. Can we do a short spec triage now? Specifically: non-negotiable acceptance criteria and risky edge cases. @Ben @Carlos
Ben (Backend): On it. Quick clarifying Q: are we prioritizing raw latency for chat or throughput/cost for embeddings here?
Carlos (ML): For the pilots: chat latency is UX-critical (goal: <=150ms p95 for short responses). Embeddings is more about throughput and unit cost for large backfills. Rerank is quality-first but with bounded latency.
Dana (SWE): I can draft a PRD skeleton with acceptance bullets. We should require: perf SLOs, quality/regression evals, deterministic fallback behavior, and smoke tests.
Evan (Designer): Add UX acceptance too — streaming vs non-streaming should match SDK behavior and error surfaces should be consistent.
Marta (Support): FYI customers saw confusing errors when rerank receives no candidates. We need explicit API error codes + recommended client behavior.
Aisha (PM): :thumbsup: Good notes. Let's capture concrete acceptance criteria per endpoint so we can sign off with sales/CS.
Ben (Backend): Chat / Completions acceptance (proposal):
- 95p latency <= 150ms for responses ~25 tokens on hosted tier
- Token-level cost delta <= 10% vs baseline model
- Streaming resumes gracefully after brief connection loss
- CLI smoke: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'` returns 200 within SLO
Carlos (ML): Embeddings acceptance (proposal):
- Bulk throughput >= 10k reqs/min on dedicated pool for batch jobs
- Eval accuracy: average cosine similarity delta <= 0.02 vs reference vectors on our eval set
- Backfill tool can checkpoint and resume without data duplication
Edge case: very short texts (<20 chars) produce low-quality vectors — doc the length threshold and auto-pad/flag.
Dana (SWE): Rerank acceptance (proposal):
- Improves MRR by >= 0.05 on customer-provided eval set or in A/B test
- Scores returned in [0,1], deterministic tie-breaking (seeded)
- If candidate set empty -> 204 with JSON explanation; fallback to cheap lexical scoring model within 300ms
Edge cases: duplicate candidates, massively large candidate lists (>5k) — cap + stream partial results.
Ben (Backend): Ops/runbooks: Canary rollout plan + automated gate: latency, error-rate, prediction-drift. If drift or error spike > threshold -> rollback to previous model within 15m. Also add billing/backfill cost guardrails.
Aisha (PM): Owners? Dana + Carlos draft initial PRD text for each endpoint. Ben adds ops acceptance and canary steps. Evan adds UX snippets and example SDK flows. Marta will draft support playbook and common customer Qs. I'll consolidate and schedule a doc review Wed 10:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Reminder: planned canary window Wed 10:00-11:00 UTC — please mark PRDs ready before then.
Marta (Support): I'll attach 3 customer examples and typical error repros to the draft.
Aisha (PM): Thanks team — I'll post a short acceptance-criteria template in #product-docs after this thread. If anyone has blocking objections to the targets above speak now, otherwise proceed on the draft.
